# Mydeen Pitchai — Laravel & TALL Stack Developer

> Mydeen Pitchai is a Senior Full Stack Developer (PHP, Laravel and the TALL stack: Tailwind CSS, Alpine.js, Laravel, Livewire) from Tirunelveli, Tamil Nadu, India with 7+ years of PHP, Laravel and WordPress experience. He builds web products that ship — e-commerce, healthcare, SaaS, sports and EdTech — and owns projects from brief to launch. RAMP Award winner (Touch Logic Technologies). This portfolio sketchboard scored 8.4/10 on [Orpetron](https://orpetron.com/sites/mydeen-pitchai-sketchboard/) (design 8.8, development 8.6, usability 7.9). Open to full-time roles and freelance projects, remote or with relocation — immediate joiner. Meanwhile building Fillam, his own product.

Stack: TALL stack — Laravel, Livewire, Alpine.js, Tailwind CSS — plus Filament, PHP, Phalcon, JavaScript, Symfony, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Zoho Books API, Zoho Creator, REST APIs, AWS S3, AWS Lambda, WordPress (incl. custom plugins and headless). AI-assisted development with Claude and ChatGPT — every line human-reviewed. Most recently Senior Full Stack Developer at OBII Kriationz Web LLP (July 2024 – October 2026).

## My product

- [Fillam](https://mydeen-pitchai.vercel.app/work/fillam): his own product, built and shipped solo — a privacy-first browser extension (Vue 3, TypeScript, WXT · Manifest V3, on-device OCR) that reads Aadhaar, PAN and certificates on the user’s computer and fills Indian government, exam and job forms in English and Tamil. Live on [Microsoft Edge Add-ons](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/cenogbihfhaifgdbcebcgfleogkldjoj) · [website](https://fillam.vercel.app)
